desc: Compute prefix distinct counts L[1..N] and suffix distinct counts R[1..N+1].
Implement a segment tree supporting point activation and range-add effects via a difference-array representation.
Sweep j from 2 to N-1: activate i = j-1, apply the update based on the previous occurrence of A[j], query the best value for i < j, and combine it with R[j+1].
Handle boundary cases such as N = 3, previous occurrence equal to 0, inactive positions, all elements equal, and all elements distinct.
